<result># Everything can rely on functions from here

function exa --wraps eza; eza $argv; end
function ls; command ls --color=tty $argv; end
function ll --wraps 'ls -l'; ls -l $argv; end
function l --wraps 'ls -alh'; ls -alh $argv; end

# for super ls
function sl
    if test -f "$argv[1]"
        bat $argv[1]
    else
        exa -Ah $argv
    end
end

function lt --wraps 'eza --sort new'; eza --sort new $argv; end

function mkfile
    set file_path "$argv[1]"
    mkdir -p (dirname "$file_path")
    touch "$file_path"
end
function mkf --wraps mkfile; mkfile $argv; end

function cs
    argparse 't/tmux' 'm/math' 'a/allow' 'd/detach' -- $argv
    or return 1

    if set -q _flag_t
        if test (count $argv) -gt 0
            direnv deny "$argv[1]"
            cd "$argv[1]" || return 1
        end
        if set -q _flag_m
            tn -a -m (set -q _flag_d; and echo -n -d)
        else if set -q _flag_d
            tn -a -d
        else
            tn -a
        end
        return
    end

    if set -q _flag_m
        if test (count $argv) -gt 0
            cd "$argv[1]" || return 1
        end
        typst_workspace
        return
    end

    if test (count $argv) -gt 0; and test -f "$argv[1]"
        e "$argv[1]"
    else
        if test (count $argv) -gt 0
            cd "$argv" || return 1
        end

        if set -q _flag_a
            direnv allow
        end
        source "./.local.fish" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
        source "./tmp/.local.fish" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
        if test -n "$VIRTUAL_ENV"
            deactivate
            set -e VIRTUAL_ENV
        end

        sl
    end
end

# go
function go
    todo manual counter-step --dev-runs
    /usr/bin/env go $argv
end

# python</result>
